title: UFO waves in Dalarna

tellings.quote:
We have in
Sweden Dalana which is in the middle of
Sweden where we have had several waves
of UFO observations.

plain: Clas Svahn, a Swedish researcher who collects UFO reports, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about Dalarna, a region in the middle of Sweden. He says that Dalarna has had several waves of UFO sightings, meaning bursts of many reports at once. He mentions it because such clusters would suggest something keeps returning to the same area.
